tasks.title: Design PostgreSQL schema (users, roles, doctors, departments, availability, slots, appointments, notifications, audit log) with a unique constraint on doctor and slot time to prevent double-booking
Set up Node.js REST API skeleton, React app shell, environment config, TLS, and migrations
Build design system and Sign In & Register screens (teal theme, inputs, buttons, tabs, bottom nav, mobile-first)
Implement registration, email verification, login, password reset with bcrypt, JWT, and role-based access control middleware
Integrate auth UI with API (register, verify, login, reset, role-based redirect to patient or staff views)
Design Find Doctors and Book Appointment screens (doctor card, chips, date strip, slot grid, modals, empty states)
Build doctor search and filter API (name, specialty, department) and weekly availability API generating open slots
Build Find Doctors UI with live search, specialty chips, results count, and next-available badge
Implement booking, reschedule, and cancel API with transactional slot locking and 24-hour cancellation rule
Build Book Appointment and My Appointments UI (slot selection, confirmation modal, conflict alert, cancel and reschedule flows)
Integrate email/SMS gateway with background job queue for booking confirmations, 24-hour reminders, and doctor cancellation alerts within 5 minutes
Build Notifications screen and reminder preference toggles (in-app feed, email/SMS settings)
Design Admin Dashboard and Notifications screens (stat cards, chart, doctor list, availability editor, preferences card)
Build admin API and UI for doctor and department CRUD, availability editor, and date-range appointment reports (total, completed, cancelled)
Add report queries and indexes, AES-256 encryption at rest, and audit logging of patient record access
End-to-end testing of booking flow, double-booking race conditions, load test at 500 concurrent users, and deploy MVP to staging

risks: Double-booking under concurrent requests may occur if slot locking or the unique constraint is implemented incorrectly
Email/SMS gateway approval, sender registration, and delivery delays could slow the reminder and notification features
Meeting the 500 concurrent user and 3-second booking targets may need extra tuning, caching, and indexing
Privacy requirements (AES-256 at rest, audit trail, RBAC on every endpoint) may add effort that threatens the short MVP timeline
Scope creep from the 4 user roles (receptionist views, reports) may delay core patient booking; keep receptionist features minimal
